sites.name: PORTS-Pike Technology Campus (OpenAI / SB Energy)
sites.owner: SB Energy (SoftBank), with the US DOE on the former Portsmouth Gaseous Diffusion Plant site
sites.users: OpenAI (20-year lease of 8 GW IT); NVIDIA exclusive compute
sites.note: Announced 17 Aug 2026: 8 GW of IT capacity leased to OpenAI for 20 years, backed by at least 10 GW of new generation (planned_mw = generation); capacity comes online in phases from 2028. Coords approximate to the DOE Portsmouth site.

sites.name: OpenAI Project Camellia (Effingham County)
sites.place: Savannah Gateway Industrial Hub near Rincon, Effingham County, Georgia
sites.note: ~$20B, ~1,400-acre campus announced Jul 2026; Georgia regulators approved a ~3.2 GW Georgia Power service contract in Aug 2026, with power phased in over 2028-2032. Coords are near Rincon (county-level).

sites.name: Meta El Paso data center
sites.owner: Meta (joint venture with BlackRock-managed funds announced Jul 2026)
sites.place: northeast El Paso, El Paso County, Texas
sites.note: 1 GW campus; Meta raised its investment to >$10B in Mar 2026 and agreed a BlackRock JV in Jul 2026, with >2,300 workers on site. Capacity begins coming online in 2028; coords approximate.

sites.name: Meta Lebanon data center
sites.note: Ground broken 11 Feb 2026 on a 1 GW, >$10B AI campus; press reports point to first operation in late 2027 to early 2028. Coords are the town centroid.

sites.name: Microsoft Pecos AI datacenter campus
sites.owner: Microsoft (co-located gas plant with Chevron's Energy Forge One)
sites.note: Announced 22 Jun 2026: ~2 GW built over 5-7 years, initially powered off-grid by a co-located natural-gas plant. 2028 is the reported first-power target for the plant, not a Microsoft opening date; coords are the town centroid.

sites.name: Nscale Ward County AI campus (Microsoft)
sites.note: Planned to host ~104k NVIDIA GB300s for Microsoft; site owner Ionic Digital reported 234 MW energized and delivered to Nscale in Aug 2026, an 89 MW expansion due H2 2027, and a 700 MW utility-capacity target pending ERCOT approval (Microsoft holds a right of first refusal on 377 MW more). GPU go-live not independently confirmed.

sites.name: Nscale Monarch Compute Campus
sites.note: Mar 2026 letter of intent for Microsoft to take 1.35 GW of Vera Rubin compute in tranches from late 2027 into 2028, on an off-grid ~2,250-acre campus with on-site gas generation (site scalable to ~8 GW). LOI stage only; coords are county-level.

sites.name: River Bend AI campus (Hut 8)
sites.place: near St. Francisville, West Feliciana Parish, Louisiana
sites.note: Tranche 1 (Dec 2025 deal) is 245 MW critical IT on 330 MW of utility capacity, with capacity expected online in 2027; Anthropic holds a right of first offer on up to 1 GW more IT at the site. Coords are the town centroid.

sites.name: Justified Data Campus (TeraWulf)
sites.note: Former Century Aluminum smelter site with ~480 MW of grid power; Anthropic signed a 20-year lease on 6 Jul 2026 for ~401 MW critical IT, delivered in phases from late 2027 to early 2028. Construction status not disclosed; coords are the town centroid.

sites.name: Nexus Hubbard campus
sites.note: 2,900-acre campus with its own gas generation; first phase ~500 MW (long-term ambition ~7.7 GW). Building 1 construction Jan 2026-Oct 2027 and Building 2 Jun 2026-Jan 2028 per filings; ~$15B bridge financing reported Jul 2026.

sites.name: Nebius Independence AI factory
sites.note: Up to 1.2 GW multi-building campus on ~400 acres near Little Blue Parkway, approved by the city on 3 Mar 2026 (power via the municipal utility); ground broken 12 May 2026, with opening expected in 2028 according to the city.

sites.name: IREN Sweetwater hub
sites.note: 2 GW of grid power across Sweetwater 1 (1.4 GW, substation energization 2026) and Sweetwater 2 (600 MW, 2027) for AI data centers; no tenant or data-hall dates disclosed. Coords approximate.

sites.name: Fermi America Project Matador (HyperGrid)
sites.place: near Amarillo (next to Pantex), Carson County, Texas
sites.note: ~8,400-acre private-power AI campus targeting 17 GW of generation (planned_mw = generation; ~6 GW permitted); first phase has AMD credit support and first power is targeted for 2026-2027. Tenant commitments beyond the first phase are not confirmed.

sites.name: Bell AI Fabric Saskatchewan campus
sites.place: Rural Municipality of Sherwood (Regina area), Saskatchewan
sites.note: 300 MW campus in Bell's sovereign 'AI Fabric' programme, with steel rising on four first-phase buildings (Bell, Oct 2026); a non-binding Sep 2026 MOU covers up to 900 MW more in the province. Coords approximate.

sites.name: Campus IA (Fouju)
sites.owner: Campus IA JV (MGX, Bpifrance, Mistral AI, NVIDIA)
sites.note: UAE-France flagship AI campus: RTE fast-track grid deal for 240 MW by end-2027, 700 MW by end-2029 and up to 1.4 GW. Permits were obtained mid-2026 and phase-1 works began Sep 2026, with first data halls due early 2028.

sites.name: SoftBank-Sesterce Bosquel AI campus
sites.owner: SoftBank Group and Sesterce joint venture
sites.note: The SoftBank-Sesterce JV was selected on 1 Jun 2026 to develop and operate this 1 GW campus after Fluidstack pulled out of its EUR 10bn, 1 GW northern-France AI project in Mar-Apr 2026; no timeline disclosed.

sites.name: Schwarz Digits AI data centre Lübbenau
sites.users: Schwarz Group / STACKIT and external customers
sites.note: EUR 11bn sovereign AI campus on a former power-plant site (groundbreaking Nov 2025, up to 100,000 GPUs); 200 MW is the phase-1 grid connection, with more modules planned and first server rooms due end-2027.

sites.name: Spain EU AI Gigafactory bid (Móra la Nova)
sites.owner: Consortium of SETT, Telefónica, ACS, Banco Santander, Multiverse Computing and the Generalitat de Catalunya
sites.place: Móra la Nova, Ribera d'Ebre, Tarragona, Catalonia
sites.note: Spain's official candidate (with a second node at San Fernando de Henares, Madrid) for the EU AI gigafactory call, which opened 30 Jul 2026 for up to seven gigafactories with awards expected in early 2027. MW not disclosed; the 2028 phase-1 date is indicative and depends on selection.

sites.name: Brookfield Strängnäs AI data centre
sites.note: SEK 95bn (~$10bn) AI data centre plan announced Jun 2025, growing the site to 750 MW over a 10-15 year build; no 2026 construction or tenant update found.

sites.name: Nebius Lappeenranta AI factory
sites.note: Announced 31 Mar 2026: a phased multi-building campus of up to 310 MW on a ~100-acre industrial site, with first customer capacity in 2027.

sites.name: QTS Cambois campus (North East AI Growth Zone)
sites.note: GBP 10bn, up to 10-building campus on the former Blyth Power Station site; enabling works since Oct 2025 and phase-1 approval Dec 2025, opening due 2028. No campus MW published (the whole North East AI Growth Zone, incl. Cobalt Park, is cited at ~1.1 GW).

sites.name: DataVita-CoreWeave AI campus (Lanarkshire AI Growth Zone)
sites.note: Designated an AI Growth Zone on 29 Jan 2026 with GBP 8.2bn of private investment including CoreWeave's GBP 1.5bn; 500 MW is planned on-site generation within four years, not IT load.

sites.name: Elsham Tech Park
sites.place: former RAF Elsham Wolds, near Scunthorpe, North Lincolnshire
sites.note: ~GBP 7.5bn, 15 data halls and ~1,000 MW of IT load for AI/hyperscale; outline planning approval reported 17 Mar 2026, construction expected from 2027 and first phase in 2029.

sites.name: OpenAI Stargate UAE (1 GW cluster)
sites.owner: G42 / Khazna Data Centers with OpenAI, Oracle, NVIDIA, Cisco and SoftBank
sites.note: $30bn, 1 GW (IT) first phase of the UAE-US AI Campus (~1.4 GW facility per Epoch); Reuters (Sep 2026) says the first 200 MW is scheduled to come online in 2026. Site coords from Epoch.

sites.name: HUMAIN Al-Saad AI data center campus
sites.note: 24 sq km hyperscale AI campus planned as six 1 GW plots in two phases; on 24 Sep 2026 HUMAIN awarded the site infrastructure works (380 kV network, 2,000 MVA bulk supply point, utilities) to Al-Yamama. No data-hall dates published; coords approximate (east Riyadh).

sites.name: DataVolt Oxagon AI campus (NEOM)
sites.note: Ground broken 31 Aug 2026 on a 100 MW HUMAIN-DataVolt tranche within a 360 MW first phase of a planned 1.5 GW renewables-powered campus; first 100 MW expected 2028. Coords approximate.

sites.name: xAI-HUMAIN AI data center (Saudi Arabia)
sites.owner: HUMAIN with xAI (now SpaceXAI) and NVIDIA
sites.note: Announced 19 Nov 2025: a 500 MW NVIDIA-GPU data center with xAI as first customer; no site or construction milestone found as of mid-2026. Point is a Riyadh placeholder.

sites.name: Firebird AI Factory Hrazdan
sites.owner: Firebird (with NVIDIA and Dell; Armenian government partnership)
sites.note: Opened 8 Aug 2026 with initial capacity well below target; Firebird plans >70,000 NVIDIA Blackwell/Rubin GPUs and 300 MW of AI capacity in Armenia by end-2027. Coords are the town centroid.

sites.name: Data Center Valley (Ekibastuz)
sites.owner: Government of Kazakhstan / Kazakhtelecom with Firebird and NVIDIA
sites.note: Up to $10bn package signed 15 Jun 2026 for a ~100,000-GPU cluster near the Ekibastuz GRES-1 coal plant; site works began by May 2026, the first 125 MW facility is due H1 2027 and a second in 2028, with phased expansion to ~1 GW.

sites.name: Microsoft-G42 geothermal data center (Olkaria)
sites.owner: G42 and Microsoft with Kenyan government partners
sites.users: Microsoft Azure East Africa cloud region (planned)
sites.place: Olkaria geothermal area, Naivasha, Nakuru County
sites.note: Flagship East African AI/cloud project announced May 2024 within a $1bn package, to run on geothermal power; no MW was stated. No construction milestone could be confirmed for 2025-2026, so treat its status as uncertain.

sites.name: Reliance Jamnagar AI data centre campus
sites.users: Reliance/Jio; Meta (168 MW built-to-suit facility announced Jun 2026)
sites.note: Reliance describes a multi-gigawatt AI campus (1 GW used here as a floor); >120 MW was expected online in H2 2026, plus a 168 MW Meta facility due within two years. Coords approximate (Jamnagar refinery area).

sites.name: Google AI hub Visakhapatnam
sites.owner: Google with AdaniConneX and Bharti Airtel (Nxtra)
sites.place: Visakhapatnam and Anakapalli districts, Andhra Pradesh
sites.note: $15bn, initially 1 GW AI campus (eventual 5 GW target reported) on ~600 acres at Rambilli, Adavivaram and Tarluvada; foundation laid 28 Apr 2026 with completion targeted for Jul 2028. Coords are the city centroid.

sites.name: Reliance AI data centre cluster (Polipalli / Bhogapuram)
sites.place: Polipalli and Bhogapuram, Vizianagaram district, Andhra Pradesh
sites.note: Andhra Pradesh allotted ~855 acres in May 2026; phase 1 is reported as 500 MW at Polipalli targeting Oct 2028, then +1 GW at Bhogapuram by 2030. May overlap Reliance's Digital Connexion (with Brookfield and Digital Realty) 1 GW Visakhapatnam plan.

sites.name: TCS HyperVault AI data centre campus (Hyderabad)
sites.owner: HyperVault AI Data Center Ltd (TCS subsidiary, with TPG)
sites.note: Exchange filing (5 Sep 2026): 264 acres secured for a liquid-cooled campus of up to 1 GW and up to Rs 70,000 crore, built in phases as demand comes; aimed at frontier AI companies and hyperscalers, no tenant named.

sites.name: Yotta D2 Greater Noida (Blackwell Ultra supercluster)
sites.place: Greater Noida, Gautam Buddh Nagar, Uttar Pradesh
sites.note: >$2bn deployment of 20,736 liquid-cooled B300 GPUs announced 18 Feb 2026 in the 60 MW D2 facility, which can scale to 250 MW; go-live was targeted for Aug 2026 (not confirmed).

sites.name: VNET Ulanqab Hyperscale 2.0 campus (Bayin)
sites.note: Epoch estimates four buildings (~252 MW facility) operating and nine buildings (~800 MW facility, ~700 MW IT) by late 2027; VNET markets the campus as gigawatt-class.

sites.name: Yiwu (Hami) desert AI computing complex
sites.owner: Government-backed projects involving multiple Chinese companies
sites.note: Bloomberg (Jul 2025) found ~70% of the compute in 39 approved Xinjiang/Qinghai AI projects (planning >115,000 restricted NVIDIA chips) concentrated near Yiwu, with some under construction; no 2026 update or MW figure found and chip supply is uncertain.

sites.name: SoftBank Sakai AI data center (former Sharp plant)
sites.users: SoftBank generative AI; universities, research institutes and companies
sites.note: Starts at ~150 MW of power-receiving capacity and grows to >250 MW on the ~450,000 sq m former Sharp LCD site; SoftBank targeted operation in 2026 but its May 2026 release still describes the site as in development.

sites.name: SoftBank Hokkaido Tomakomai AI data center
sites.note: ~700,000 sq m renewables-powered campus expected to exceed 300 MW; ground broken Apr 2025, opening targeted in FY2026 (which ends Mar 2027). Coords are the city centroid.

sites.name: SK-AWS Ulsan AI data center
sites.owner: SK Group (SK Telecom / SK Broadband) with AWS
sites.note: 15-year SK-AWS partnership (Jun 2025) with operations scheduled from 2027; SKT said in Jul 2026 the site is under construction and will scale past 1 GW, seeding a >2 GW south-east cluster in its 15 GW plan. Coords are the city centroid.

sites.name: National AI Computing Center (Solaseado, Haenam)
sites.owner: Korean government (MSIT) with a Samsung SDS-led consortium incl. Naver Cloud
sites.note: Flagship national AI compute project (below 100 MW): ground broken 3 Aug 2026 for ~15,000 advanced AI chips by 2028, with power demand rising from 40 to 80 MW; anchors a planned ~1 GW Solaseado data center park.

sites.name: Naver-NVIDIA-Brookfield AI factory (GAK Sejong)
sites.owner: Naver Cloud with NVIDIA; Brookfield as capital partner
sites.note: $10bn plan (NVIDIA $1bn equity, Brookfield up to $9bn) starting at the GAK Sejong hub: 55 MW from H1 2027, 200 MW by 2028 and ~1 GW long term, likely spanning more sites.

sites.name: NEXTDC S7 Eastern Creek (OpenAI for Australia)
sites.place: Eastern Creek, Western Sydney, New South Wales
sites.note: 550+ MW (IT) campus still in planning and subject to development approval; an OpenAI-NEXTDC MoU (Dec 2025) covers a sovereign AI campus with the first phase targeted for H2 2027. No binding OpenAI offtake disclosed.

sites.name: Firmus Project Southgate, Tailem Bend AI factory
sites.note: ~1 GW critical IT (~1.2 GW grid connection) first-phase site of Firmus's NVIDIA-backed Project Southgate, supported by a Jun 2026 600 MW supply deal; subject to planning approval (a twin Stirling North site is planned at ~1.5 GW).

sites.name: ByteDance (TikTok) data center campus, Pecém
sites.owner: Omnia (Pátria Investments); power from Casa dos Ventos
sites.place: Pecém Industrial and Port Complex (CIPP), near Fortaleza, Ceará
sites.note: Announced Dec 2025 (>R$200bn over time); phase 1 is ~200 MW in 20 halls for ByteDance, with only the structural pillars up in Jul 2026 and first operations targeted for 2027. Bloomberg-reported potential of almost 1 GW (planned_mw); coords approximate for the Pecém complex.

sites.name: Rio AI City
sites.owner: Elea Data Centers (I Squared Capital) with Rio de Janeiro City Hall
sites.place: Parque Olímpico, Barra da Tijuca, Rio de Janeiro
sites.note: Planned at 1.5 GW initially and up to ~3.2 GW; a Jun 2026 city MoU (with US$550m from I Squared) targets ~3 GW by 2032 (expected_year = completion). The first new building (RJO2, ~80 MW) is under construction next to Elea's existing RJO1.

sites.name: Scala AI City
sites.place: Eldorado do Sul, Rio Grande do Sul
sites.note: Planned 4.75 GW campus (first phase ~50 MW, R$3bn); as of Jul 2026 Scala was awaiting environmental, urban and road licences, expected to start construction in 2027 and to bring the first unit online in late 2028 to early 2029.

sites.name: Terranova Campinas AI campus
sites.note: AI-oriented, liquid-cooled campus whose phase 1 construction began Aug 2026: 216 MW IT initially, expandable to 386 MW IT, with opening targeted for 2027 and phases through 2029.
